note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre. Plan sizes from the trace of the straightened front photo (40 mm case, listing; strap between the lugs 19.7 mm measured; listing: 12 mm thick). Heights before the house depth scale. Dial print, applied numerals, minute ring and the day-date window come from the dial map; the strap leather from the strap map (12 o'clock strap of the photo, both sides).

case.note: (r, z): polished flank rounding into the wide domed polished bezel (18.25-20 mm in the photo); inner lip over the minute ring

lug.note: stepped lugs: outer polished part (top z at the case, at the tip) and a lower inner rail beside the strap, groove between (photo)

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (22.25 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass. Black base colour keeps the dial from hazing
